name: @alm4dataverse/azdo-extensions
description: Azure DevOps tasks for ALM4Dataverse with WorkloadIdentityFederation support

scripts.build: tsc && copyfiles -u 1 "src/tasks/**/task.json" dist && tfx extension create
scripts.publish: npm run build && tfx extension publish --publisher ALM4Dataverse --manifest-js vss-extension.json --share-with rnwsol

author: ALM4Dataverse
